title: Continuous Local Residual Coordinates
negative_results: forward refuses a depth beyond the construction floor

claims.statement: forward(point, depth) returns (face, path, residual) where residual is the point's barycentric offset from the terminal cell centroid (its three components sum to zero); inverse reconstructs the direction as cell_centroid (+) residual.

The reversible CW-HCM-ICO core round-trips a synthetic point through (face, path, residual) and back to full floating-point precision (observed error <= 1e-9, typically ~1e-16) over a synthetic sweep and across depths 0..13.

A zero residual reconstructs the terminal cell centroid exactly. An exact canonical round-trip is a verified property of the codec, not evidence about any source vector. SOURCE_VECTOR_GEOGRAPHIC_SEMANTICS_NOT_CLAIMED; PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
